resources.string: Your security session expired. Try again; if it continues, sign out and sign in again.

Too many attempts in a row. Try again in %1$d s.

The server requires a secure connection. Use an address that starts with https://.
No internet connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data.

The server could not be found. Check your internet connection and the server address.

The server had a problem processing the request. Try again later.
The server does not recognise this request. The app or the server address may be out of date.
